notes.title: GMod, SFM, D2 download types being discontinued
notes.notes:
Hello Fusers! We’ve made some changes to the Mixamo website that unfortunately include removing the ability to download a Fuse character in the Source Filmmaker, Garry’s Mod and Dota 2 file types.

Why would we do this, you ask? Frankly, those services have had stability issues, and we are instead focusing our resources on continuing to support the most popular download types that support animation workflows into production game engines and 3D software.

[h1]Alternative solutions can be achieved by following this workflow
[/h1][url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=220878558]Fuse to the Source Engine (Source Filmmaker, Garry's Mod, etc)[/url]

We appreciate your understanding while we continue to hone Fuse and Mixamo as the fast and effective 3D content pipeline made for creatives.

notes.title: Fuse 1.4 News and Mixamo Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey Errbody!

We have a new blog post up on the Mixamo website detailing some of the planned updates for our products, we would love if you wanted to check it out here:

[url=http://blog.mixamo.com/mixamo-roadmap-face-plus-now-free-and-a-focus-on-core-products-3d-animation-software][img]http://cdn2.hubspot.net/hubfs/301934/Tyler_FP.gif?t=1428711925588[/img][/url]
http://blog.mixamo.com/mixamo-roadmap-face-plus-now-free-and-a-focus-on-core-products-3d-animation-software


[h1]What’s Next for Fuse?[/h1]

We continue working to improve Fuse, our 3D character creator. This week, Fuse character uploads will be pointed towards Mixamo 2.0, which will mean faster asset processing, no viewer plugin, and blendshape settings that are remembered by the website, minimizing the amount of time you will need to re-rig your character. Some rocking new features you can look for in Fuse 1.4 include:
[list]
[*][b]Automatic hat and hair fitting[/b] - never worry about hat-hair again
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Jc2rkbo.png[/img]
[*][b]Automatically generate multiple character mesh resolutions[/b] - polycounts for desktop and mobile, and [i]automatic[/i] generation of the mid and low res versions for imported characters (as long as the UV templates are followed)
[*][b]Soft mod tools for clothing and hair adjustments[/b] - get the perfect fit
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Y7RKuzl.gif[/img]
[/list]
There will definitely be more, but we just wanted to confirm the "for sure" items. We're also planning on adding a ton of medieval/fantasy content (most popular survey result). No definite release date set right now, but the smart money is on some time in June or the beginning of July.

Got a great idea that would make Fuse even more useful in your production pipeline? Drop us some suggestions on proposed features and content you want to see added!

\m/ Fuse on \m/

notes.title: Fuse 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Today I’m happy to share all the new features and content we’ve been working hard to get into the newest version of Fuse.  We're excited to see how you use the new toon, aged and teenager character meshes and all the  military/operational clothing content you’ve been asking for to create the unique characters you need. There are also a few other surprises in store for this release.

[h1]New Download Types for Garry’s Mod and Source Filmmaker[/h1]

Today marks a full year of Fuse being available as a standalone application available on Steam.  

To celebrate our Steam-a-versary we made it easier to get your unique Fuse character into the popular Source engine applications, Garry's Mod and Source Filmmaker.  Now when you create a 3D character with Fuse and Auto-Rig it on Mixamo, you have the option to download it as a ragdoll for Gmod or a character and animation for SFM.

Now you can download Fuse characters to use in Gmod or SFM

[h1]Tutorials to guide the way[/h1]

Need some guidance on how to work with the new download types?  Click on the links below for the specific tutorial you need.  And don't be shy about exploring the new Mixamo Community where you can find all the documentation, forums and support you need for all things Mixamo.

[list]
[*] [url=https://community.mixamo.com/hc/en-us/articles/204187833-Tutorial-Fuse-to-Gary-s-Mod-Ragdoll?__hstc=233546881.f8c0c77f994335c737466ec7979ead63.1415042003243.1415042003243.1415297475785.2&__hssc=233546881.2.1415297475785&__hsfp=2297233444]Garry's Mod rag doll for Fuse character Tutorial[/url]
[*] [url=https://community.mixamo.com/hc/en-us/articles/203859456-Tutorial-Fuse-to-Source-Filmmaker?__hstc=233546881.f8c0c77f994335c737466ec7979ead63.1415042003243.1415042003243.1415297475785.2&__hssc=233546881.2.1415297475785&__hsfp=2297233444]Tutorial on getting a character and animation from Fuse into SFM[/url]
[/list]

[h1]A Special Thanks[/h1]

Thank you to our SFM guru community activists for helping us understand the SFM import process: Casey Billadeau, Grigory Revzin, Pte Jack, and Daniel Barreiro.  Without these guys, the download type for SFM would not be possible!


[h1]What Else is New in Fuse 1.3?[/h1]

What did our Fuse survey tell us that you wanted to see more of?  Why, cartooney characters, aged characters and more realistic teenage characters of course!   

[list]
[*] Toons, aliens and combat-ready 3D characters are yours to create in Fuse 1.3
[*] The full list of new features and content in Fuse v1.3!:
[*] New Toon, Aged, and Teen character content- No more generational gaps!
[*] New Military and Occupational Content - Doctors, Police Officers, Firefighters... build your virtual city from the ground up!
[*] Reference Image Planes - Import an image to use a reference while you are creating your custom character
[*] Asynchronous Substance Loading - Allows you to more quickly construct your character and add clothing while the substances are rendered in the background
[*] Retopologized Characters with higher quality edge loops and face definition
[*] Dynamic Cloth Wear - Updated substance parameters allow you to weather raised edges of your character's clothing
[*] Better selection visibility - previous bounding boxes are now form-fitting highlights around a selected object
[*] 10 New Substances!
[/list]

So there you have it, folks.  Another launch of Fuse, one year older and a whole lot smarter.  We hope its everything you wanted and more.  If you have comments or want to vote for what you’d like to see in Fuse, head on over to the Mixamo Community and chime in on the [url=https://community.mixamo.com/hc/communities/public/topics/200121473-Ideas-Fuse?__hstc=233546881.f8c0c77f994335c737466ec7979ead63.1415042003243.1415042003243.1415297475785.2&__hssc=233546881.2.1415297475785&__hsfp=2297233444]Fuse Ideas Forum[/url].

And stay tuned for the next release of Fuse sometime in early 2015.  We’ll be unveiling some very exciting additions to the Fuse ecosystem.

In the meantime, Happy Fusing!

notes.title: New Mixamo.com Price Plans - Animation For All
notes.notes:
Hi Community!

So after a couple months of work, pouring over data, and collaboration with pricing professionals, we (Mixamo) have rolled out a new pricing model on our site ([url]www.mixamo.com[/url]) prioritizing accessibility for developers and artists at all levels.

Here's the skinny:
[list][*][b]Assets are a simple, flat rate.[/b]  A la carte pay per use costs are reduced across the board.

[*][b]Three tiers of plans to choose from.[/b]  In addition to All Access, we are now offering Starter and Indie plans at price points that appeal to a wider range of users.

[*][b]More flexibility.[/b]  You can pay per use, choose a month-to-month plan or pay for a year up front and get 2 months free and be able to download all the animations allotted at that level right away. [/list]

More info:
[url]http://www.cgrecord.net/2014/08/mixamo-launches-new-more-affordable.html?m=1[/url]

[url]http://blog.mixamo.com/more-mixamo-plans-for-all[/url]

[url]https://www.mixamo.com/pricing[/url]

[b]What does this mean for Fuse on Steam?![/b] Well that depends on what you want it to mean! The Fuse you know and love isn't going anywhere, and we're going to keep adding content and features with updates like always. The new Mixamo pricing plans can enhance your workflow by adding flexibility to our products to fit your development needs as they arise.

You'll notice the $50/mo Indie plan includes Fuse. But why would we still list the Steam version at $100 you might say? Shenanigans you might say?? The Steam version gets automatic updates foreva, while the standalone Fuse is stuck at the version that was available while the plan was active, and so far we've updated Fuse 5 times, so hooray that! You gets the Fuse FOREVA! And most of you bought Fuse when it was on sale anyway ¯\_(ツ)_/¯

Happy to answer any and all questions and and field any and all feedback. Fuse on! \m/

notes.title: Fuse v1.2: Virtual Assets, 2k Textures, Facial Blendshapes... the goods
notes.notes:
Hey Community!

Fuse 1.2 is out and it is quite a looker! The Skin substance was completely overhauled, resulting in [b]2k skin textures[/b], higher quality details, and 3x the previous number of skin customizing options.

ALSO! [b]Facial Animation Blendshapes[/b]. It's a real thing. Upload your character to Mixamo to be autorigged. Enable facial blendshapes. Download your character. BAM. You have facial blendshapes. [b]50 of them[/b], to the face. 'nuff said.

[b]The new jams in v1.2!:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Virtual Assets[/b] - Create character and clothing presets, customize your library! Make a character, hit the Star button at the top, and watch as that character is turned into a Fusible asset!
[*] [b]2k Skin Textures[/b] - Hi-res for your pleasure! By default textures are set to 1k for speed, enable 2k in the substance menu
[*] [b]Advanced Skin Substance [/b] - Increased quality and 3x the number of customization options! Get crazy!
[*] [b]Realistic lighting and PBR shading[/b] - Just makes stuff look so dang good
[*] [b]Facial Animation Blendshapes[/b] - Call us crazy, but this seemed like a win-win...winwinwin. When you upload your character to Mixamo to be Autorigged, you can now have 50 facial animation blendshapes generated automatically! 
[*] [b]17 New Substances![/b] Metal and Leather armors, new fabrics
[/list]

Treat yo' self!

-T

notes.title: Fuse v1.1 is out, and it's the biggest one yet!!!
notes.notes:
Hey Community!

Fuse's biggest update yet is rolling out, and it is some next-level stuff:

[b](╯°[/b]□[b]°）╯︵ ┻━┻ [/b]

[b]New in v1.1!:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Face and Body customization![/b] Customize your character with over 280 possible adjustment shapes. You can click and drag on UI controllers or use old-school sliders in a new workspace, "Customize", up to you!
[*] [b]Face and Body customization for imported characters![/b] Yup! If you import a character that is based on the Fuse template or has matching UVs, those 280 customization shapes will be generated [i]automatically[/i]!
[*] Now you can [b]search[/b] your content library!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Fuse, 50% off
notes.notes:
Fuse is Now Available on Steam!
Fuse is a data-driven, modular 3D character creator that comes packaged with 60+ body parts, 90+ clothing meshes, 25 dynamic texturing substances, and 2 free Auto-Rigs per week. The new Asset Import feature allows you to integrate custom assets with the existing library. Workflows are available for Gmod, SFM and Source.

Version 1.0 is Now Available on Steam, at 50% off.

Fuse was developed in collaboration between Mixamo and Vladlen Koltun’s research group at Stanford University, with Siddhartha Chaudhuri as chief architect and programmer. With the last beta release, Fuse integrates Allegorithmic’s Substance technology for a complete character modeling solution. Fuse offers an unprecedented approach to high quality 3D character creation. Users can browse through a vast number of mesh and texture choices to get custom built characters in a matter of minutes.

notes.title: Fuse v1.0 is released!
notes.notes:
Hey community, big update with a lot of new stuff! The biggest and baddest of all is the new [b]Asset Import feature[/b]. This allows you to add your own custom gear or characters to the Fuse database so you can mix and match them!

And this is just the beginning. We eventually want to open up a space where community members can swap, sell even just give away their own custom content.

[b]“The whole is greater than the sum of its parts.”[/b]
― [i]Aristotle[/i]

Check out the import guide here and also pick up a copy of the developer package to get you started:
[url]http://www.mixamo.com/fuse/import/[/url]

Other great stuff in the update: Improved character quality, memory optimization, 2 free rigs a week, and nipples! Your copy of Fuse should update automatically in your Steam client (like pretty much everything else).

ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ
Here's the high level stuff:
[b]New in v1.0!:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Import custom content![/b]
[*] Higher quality characters, default 1k resolution, improved topology
[*] Female models and textures now have nipples
[*] New clothing
[*] An additional free autorig per week
[*] Memory optimizations
[*] Save substance defaults for clothing
[*] Dynamic textured thumbnails
[*] Global preferences menu for exports
[/list]

Next up: adjustable facial features and higher quality TF2 characters!

-T

notes.title: December Update to Fuse!
notes.notes:
Hey Community! We're excited to let you know that the December update to Fuse has been rolled out. The update includes some new features, much improved existing ones, a bug fix or two, and some brand new content! Your copy of Fuse should update automatically in your Steam client (like pretty much everything else).

Here's a changelog:[list]
[*]Added Save/Open functionality for your characters
[*]Added "Triangulate Mesh" Export option
[*]Added Poly Count, Triangle Count (View/Show Poly Count)
[*]Light mode cycling (Key Light, 3-Point Light, MatCap)
[*]Improved camera navigation
[*]Added axis labels (Windows)
[*]Fixed AMD OpenGL issue on Mac
[*]1-Click Substance UI improvements 
- You can now preview multiple substances easily, as the current substance remains active after selecting a new substance.
- substance selection is one click, no more "Change Substance" button
- made substance category tabs less wide, to allow whole window to be narrower
[*]Autosave every 10 minutes to ~/fuse_autosave.fuse
[*]New Content added:
- 2 heads
- 7 glasses
- 3 polygonal strip hair meshes with alpha masking
- 15 texture based hair options in the body texture controls
- 4 hats
- 1 bikini top and bottom

There are many exciting things coming up for Fuse in the new year, stay tuned, and [b]Happy Holidays![/b]
-T

notes.title: Fuse Needs Reviews!
notes.notes:
Hi community!

As you may have noticed, Valve recently added public reviews to Steam, and we would love to hear what you have to say! We hope that Fuse is living up to your expectations, and are looking forward to the future!

[b]New features that will be available soon:[/b] File Save and Open functionality, Improved texture selection, Polygon strip hair, Export as triangles, Display number of polygons in the workspace, and of course, new content will be added to the existing Fuse library [b]fo' free![/b]

We are already doing R&D on changing individual facial features, a highly desired feature that will definitely be coming in a future update, as well as importing your own models.

As we're all getting ready to chow on some good food, one or two of us fire up some menorahs, and spend some quality time with family, the team working on Fuse wanted to give thanks to everyone who has been supportive of us. We truly appreciate your input and support, and look forward to making Fuse the best dern character creator out there!

[b]Happy Thanksgiving![/b]
-T

Fuse - Clothing Substances Expansion by Allegorithmic, all new content for Fuse is Now Available on Steam and is 50% off!*

The Clothing Substance Expansion Pack by Allegorithmic doubles the smart texture library in Fuse with an additional 25 dynamic substances: complex fabric weaves like Herringbone, Houndstooth, Damask; expanded patterns like floral prints and plaid variations; organics like Zebra/Tiger stripes and reptilian scales; synthetics like Rubber and Plastic, and Brushed metal and a Copper substance that can age dynamically.

Multiply the amount of customization available for your Fuse clothing with the Clothing Substance Expansion!

This DLC is currently only available for Windows. A Mac compatible version will be available in the near future.

notes.title: Now Available - Fuse, 50% off!
notes.notes:
Fuse is Now Available on Steam Early Access and is 50% off!*

Fuse offers an unprecedented approach to high quality 3D character creation. Users can browse through a vast number of mesh and texture choices to get custom built, automatically rigged, animation-ready characters in a matter of minutes.

Fuse is a data-driven modular 3D character creator. It was developed in collaboration between Mixamo and Vladlen Koltun’s research group at Stanford University, with Siddhartha Chaudhuri as chief architect and programmer. With the latest release, Fuse integrates Allegorithmic’s Substance technology to add dynamic texturing, an expanded content library, and greatly increased speed optimizations for a universal character modeling solution. With Fuse, users can browse, resize, customize and combine various body parts, textures, materials, clothing and accessories, to easily generate high-quality, royalty-free 3D characters in seconds. Through seamless integration with Mixamo’s online 3D animation platform, users can also effortlessly animate their Fuse characters.

*Offer ends November 14 at 10AM Pacific Time
